maya (People Ops): Heads-up: we're harmonizing rules for contractor -> FTE conversions and how that affects promotion eligibility and retro pay. Please share edge cases.

dan (Eng Manager): Two real cases: (1) contractor converted, then immediately took on lead responsibilities; (2) conversion happened but compensation was aligned to market lower than peers.

harpreet (IC): For case 1, can we treat the start of higher-level responsibilities as the eligibility date, or must the FTE start date be used?

maya (People Ops): Short answer: promotion eligibility defaults to FTE start + 90 days. Exception: for clear retention/mission-critical cases, managers can request an "accelerated review" with manager rationale + director signoff. If accelerated and approved, effective date = approval date; retro pay is pro-rated back to conversion date.

dan (Eng Manager): What counts as "clear retention"?

maya (People Ops): Examples: active external offer, critical project risk if lost, or role gap causing product impact. Include evidence (offer details redacted OK) and proposed comp target. We'll triage within 48 hours.

recruiting-bot: :memo: Reminder: conversion grants follow new-hire equity guidelines. For acceleration requests, include recruiting note. (https://go.company/recruiting-guides)

harpreet (IC): If promo goes through but comp band is frozen, will we get a title only?

maya (People Ops): There are two tracks: (A) title-only with documented path/timeline to comp band change, or (B) immediate comp adjustment if budget/approval exists. Managers should provide a timeline and suggested range for band movement; People Ops will escalate to comp committee.

dan (Eng Manager): Can we backdate titles to reflect earlier work?

maya (People Ops): Titles can be backdated up to 30 days with manager note + director approval. More than 30 days needs HRBP signoff and justification. Payroll official effective dates cannot be backdated beyond payroll system constraints.

harpreet (IC): How do we communicate retro payments and tax implications?

maya (People Ops): Payroll will do tax withholding per standard rules; retro payments appear on next payroll run after approval. People Ops will notify individuals and managers of timing. If the retro amount is large, payroll may split the payment across two periods for tax smoothing.

dan (Eng Manager): Any templates for manager submission?

maya (People Ops): Yes — manager note template: 1) Case summary (one paragraph), 2) Dates (conversion, responsibility start), 3) Evidence links, 4) Requested outcome (title, comp delta, equity ask), 5) Director sign-off line. I'll post the template in the promo toolkit.

harpreet (IC): Thanks — helps a lot.

maya (People Ops): I'll pull this into a short mini-policy and upload by EOD. If you have an active candidate, DM me the thread link and tag your director for fast-tracking.
